### Note 22:55 CDT (Claude, author-approved) — additions for the X6a REPORT and the X6b PROTOCOL

**X6a, saved-data addition (no new transitions, within the REPORT or a second <= 1 SU REPORT job):**
from the saved X6a CE least-squares fits on family S (K0 = 0, fixed certificates), compute the
dense and rank-2 CE gains and their exact gaps, and report per n in {24,36,48,72} and N the
paired ratio g(dense)/g(truncated) (median and system-bootstrap 95% CI over pairs with both
stable), stable counts per arm, and the failure-inclusive version (unstable = +infinity; drop
only pairs where both are unstable, and report how many). Same for family U, with medians of
||P_K0|| and v_star per n. Purpose: CE n/r scaling at fixed certificates.

**X6b PROTOCOL must additionally include (pre-registered):**
1. Rungs base_n x {1/64, 1/16, 1/4, 1} (add 1/64 if the measured cost allows), to show the
   transition from the low-precision to the high-precision regime; base_n fixed from the
   X6a pilot-only calibration before any X6b formal run, never re-chosen from formal outcomes.
2. At every rung, both arms with identical primitive transitions: final gap (absolute and
   relative, failure-inclusive median/IQR), stable counts, paired ratio over both-stable pairs
   and the failure-inclusive version.
3. Budget-to-epsilon from the rung ladder for relative gap 0.1 and 0.05: smallest rung with
   >= 29/32 runs attaining it, per arm, right-censored, no interpolation; system bootstrap.
4. rho_op and the projection coefficient along the path are diagnostics computed with the
   simulator only; they are never inputs of the learners.

### Review 23:00 CDT (Claude) — X6a REPORT: ACCEPTED; S/n36 calibration extension authorized

X6a REPORT accepted as an estimation/mechanism result (no terminal-cost claim). Consistent
with my independent local Monte Carlo (S, N = 2048: trunc/dense error ratio rising with n;
truncated projection coefficient well below 1 at low N, near 1 at high N).
1. **S/n36 censoring:** authorized a pilot-only, dense-only NPG calibration extension on the
   S pilots 9101/9102 x the 4 calibration seeds at N = 1,048,576 and 2,097,152 blocks
   (nested, same collector). Take the smallest N with pilot median rho_op <= 1 as base_36;
   if still censored, report and keep n36 out of X6b. Do not use formal data.
2. Then run the saved-data CE addition of the 22:55 note (fixed-certificate CE ratios on S),
   and propose the X6b PROTOCOL with bases 524288 / base_36 / 2097152 / 4194304 and all
   items of the 22:55 note; measure costs per rung before any FORMAL request. X6c (U family)
   is deferred: its pilot calibration is censored everywhere, so it needs its own decision.
